{{Top}}
[[File:DSTurbolaser.png|thumb|right|250px|An [[XX-9 heavy turbolaser/Legends|XX-9 heavy turbolaser]] on the first [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]]]
{{Quote|Order the defense towers to fire ion cannons and turbolasers at will!|[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]] to [[Novar (Human)|Novar]]|<ref name="TotJAudio">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
The '''turbolaser''' was the immensely scaled-up version of the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. These weapons were generally mounted on rotating turrets, which were commonly installed in banks on [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], [[Space station/Legends|space stations]] and orbital facilities. Some immobile variants, like those housed within [[Iziz defense tower|defense towers]] of the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], were used on the ground. [[Agrocite/Legends|Agrocite]], an extremely rare ore that was found only on [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] and [[Simocadia]], was known to greatly [[Agrocite cannon|enhance]] a turbolaser's destructive power. [[Mirkanite/Legends|Mirkanite]] was also used in the production of heavy turbolasers.

==Description==
{{Quote|We count thirty Rebel ships, Lord Vader, but they're so small they're evading our turbolasers.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tanbris/Legends|Tanbris]], during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]|<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:XX-9_Turbolasers_SWArmada.png|thumb|right|250px|The devastating effects of heavy turbolasers]]
Turbolasers were large-scale energy weapons<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> that were installed aboard [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], [[Space station/Legends|space stations]], and orbital facilities. Considerably more powerful than standard [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]],<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> turbolasers were strong enough to defeat a [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], or to punch through its [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating. Turbolasers were the most common weapon mounted on [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].<ref name="EGWT" />

Turbolasers were two-stage supercharged [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. The [[Laser/Legends|laser]] created an energy beam that was fed into the [[turbolaser actuator]]. Inside the actuator, the beam interacted with an energized stream of [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]]. The interaction produced an intense blast that was then focused through the [[galven coil]]s in the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] of the turbolaser.<ref name="EGWT" /> The resulting blast was a bolt of energy triple the power of a bolt produced by a standard laser cannon.<ref name="NEGWT" />

The power requirements for a turbolaser were immense, requiring each weapon to have its own dedicated [[Turbine/Legends|turbine]], supplemented by multiple [[capacitor bank]]s. Energy flow to the weapon was regulated by the [[Power core/Legends|power core]], bleeding off excess energy and stopping power surges to protect the turbolaser from exploding. To allow the capacitors to charge enough, turbolasers fired at a rate of two [[Standard second|seconds]] between shots. The tremendous amount of wast heat generated by turbolasers required them to have cryosystems; each laser barrel was wrapped in a [[cooling sleeve]], and a [[Cooling unit/Legends|cooling unit]] was behind the [[Laser actuator/Legends|laser actuator]].<ref name="EGWT" />

Maintenance of turbolasers was an extensive and intensive procedure to reduce the chance of a burnout. At best, the weapon could be knocked offline, at worst, an explosive overload that destroyed the turbolaser and its weapons crew. Cooling sleeve components, [[Galven tubing|galven tube]] circuits, and [[Energization crystal/Legends|energization crystals]] were frequently replaced.<ref name="EGWT" />

[[File:The_Imperial_Fist_IE.png|thumb|left|250px|A turbolaser blast impacts a planet's surface]]
Turbolasers were intended for ship-to-ship [[Space warfare/Legends|combat]], and were not designed to target faster and more nimble craft such as [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Starships were equipped with banks of turbolasers, linked together with computerized fire-control systems so that they could fire in coordinated and sustained volleys.<ref name="EGWT" /> Poorly arranged turbolaser emplacements could be a disadvantage to a starship if they created gaps in the vessel's defensive screen.<ref name="NEGWT" />

The range of a turbolaser was greater than that of a conventional laser cannon, doubling or even tripling the weapon's effective range. Turbolasers mounted on ships in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] were capable of [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|striking]] the surface. Small vessels would typically carry a few turbolasers, while larger capital ships such as the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] had sixty [[XX-9 heavy turbolaser/Legends|XX-9 heavy turbolasers]].<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
[[File:BeastWars1.jpg|thumb|right|170px|Manual, groundside turbolasers used in 4,000 BBY, during the Battle of Iziz]]
[[4000 BBY/Legends|Thousands of years earlier]], turbolaser batteries were used [[Battle of Iziz|against]] the [[Beast Riders]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]]'s contingent of Onderonian [[Wave gunner]]s. These batteries were mounted inside the [[Iziz defense tower|defense towers]] that lined the walls of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], Onderon's single great city. Along with [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], the turbolaser batteries were designed to combat the [[Drexl|flying beasts]] used as war mounts by the Beast Riders.

The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] deployed turbolaser cannons mounted atop a heavy [[Walker/Legends|all-terrain drive unit]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. These [[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery|SPHA-T walkers]] proved instrumental in taking down numerous [[Core ship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class core ships]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], and these turbolasers were later installed inside the hangar bays of ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers for effective ship-to-ship broadsides.

A twin turbolaser cannon on a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] was powerful enough to melt an ice [[Moon/Legends|moon]] 1,000 kilometers in diameter, or pierce the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] of a 10-kilometer-wide [[Grade III battle station/Legends|Grade III battle station]], and four star frigates could easily outgun a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="ROTSICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] created an upgraded turbolaser known as the "[[Agrocite cannon]]," which used rare [[Agrocite/Legends|Agrocite]] to greatly enhance the cannon's power. The cannon was so powerful it could destroy a ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer in a single shot. Three such cannons were used during the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]].

Under the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], possession of turbolasers were strictly controlled. However, turbolasers were commonly available on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]], and were frequently purchased by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], and outlaws.<ref name="EGWT" />

When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] rose to power, it maintained similar restrictions, but waivers were granted to allied governments.<ref name="EGWT" /> The New Republic also allowed its military contractors to continue research into creating more powerful versions of turbolasers, including quick-recharge turbolasers. This variant proved effective during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="NEGWT" />

Following the war, a variety of long-range turbolasers were produced, with an even longer range than the standard type, though at the expense of greater power drain; even when mounted on an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]], the drain was noticeable. This limited their deployment to a number of [[Hapan Battle Dragon]]s and the Star Destroyer [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']]. [[Darth Caedus]] fired the turbolasers on the latter during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kashyyyk]], causing forest fires on the planet's surface.
